text.title: API Versioning Procedure
text.summary: 6-step procedure applying the api-versioning methodology end-to-end. Each step lists inputs, action, output, and optional decision gate.

step.name: pick-scheme
step.input: Audience (public / B2B / internal) + existing info.x-versioning block + tooling
step.action: Choose exactly one scheme: url-path for public and B2C; accept-header for B2B with strict content negotiation; header-key for an internal control plane. Record it in info.x-versioning. If a scheme is already recorded, keep it — do not re-open the choice per change.
step.output: scheme tag (url-path | accept-header | header-key) recorded in the spec
step.decision-gate: If the version currently travels in the request body, or schemes differ across endpoints, fix that first — rules no-version-in-payload and one-scheme-per-api.

step.name: detect-breaking-change
step.action: Run oasdiff breaking with --fail-on ERR. Classify each diff with the breaking-change-classifier: removed/renamed field, tightened validation, removed/renamed status code, changed response shape, or optional-became-required are breaking; added optional fields and new endpoints are additive; description-only edits are docs-only. Collect the breaking signals verbatim.
step.output: diff.json with breaking changes (may be empty) + change_kind (breaking | additive | docs-only) + breaking signal list
step.decision-gate: If no breaking changes, STOP — minor bump for additive, patch for docs-only, no version ceremony.

step.name: decide-version-strategy
step.action: Apply rule additive-first + url-path-default. Decide: revert change, add nullable field, or create vN+1.
step.decision-gate: If decision != vN+1, apply the additive alternative and STOP.

step.name: scaffold-vN+1
step.action: Copy the affected handlers into v(N+1) module. Edit response shape. Mount the new router in the application factory.
step.output: v(N+1) router file + updated router registration

step.name: wire-deprecation-middleware
step.input: ops/sunset.yaml entry for vN route + middleware + audience
step.action: Size the deprecation window first: >= 90 days for a public API, >= 30 for an internal one; sunset_date = today + window. Mark the vN route as deprecated in ops/sunset.yaml with that ISO date; ensure middleware injects Deprecation/Sunset/Link headers on every vN response.
step.output: Updated sunset.yaml with deprecation_window_days + sunset_date + middleware test
step.decision-gate: change_kind=breaking with a minor or patch bump, or a public window under 90 days → verdict=fail, do not ship.

step.name: ship-and-measure
step.action: Deploy; verify per-version traffic split visible. Announce deprecation 6 months in advance.
step.decision-gate: Sunset only after 30 days of zero traffic on vN.
